lines.text: Why would a car ramp that holds 25000 pounds still be a death trap?
He crushes eleven brands in a press and the plastic Pittsburgh ramps take almost 25000 pounds.
That's almost eight times their rating because the plastic ribs spread the load like a honeycomb.
beats: ai:a golden honeycomb holding up a heavy steel weight macro

lines.text: Meanwhile a pair of steel ramps folds flat under a tractor.
Because thin steel buckles once it starts to bend while the ribs keep sharing the load.
beats: ai:a thin steel sheet buckling and folding under a heavy load in slow motion

lines.text: So crushing is the one thing you don't need to worry about.
On smooth concrete almost every ramp slides and one even shoots out from under a truck.
That's friction because a climbing tire shoves the ramp forward and one rubber stop can't hold it.
beats: ai:a car tire pushing a black plastic ramp forward across smooth concrete

lines.text: A damp cloth underneath helped some of the plastic ones grip which is a free fix anyone can try.
So check for grip and set the parking brake before you crawl under.
beats: ai:a hand pulling up a car parking brake lever
ai:a mechanic lying on a creeper next to a car up on ramps
